basic_info.description: Urban living at its best! Modern, bright and chic condo featuring an open entertainer's floor plan, floor to ceiling windows with beautiful Downtown views & designer finishes throughout. Large chef's kitchen w/a generous island and eating/entertaining area features premium appliances including top of the line integrated Thermador fridge, stone countertops and ample, high end cabinetry. The living room with dining area offers space to gather and features stylish concrete accents, DuChateau Riverstone collection hardwood floors & Downtown views. Spacious & bright bedroom with Downtown views, new carpet, multiple closets & in-unit W/D. Den features a modern metal framed glass sliding panel system enabling enclosure for use as a 2nd bedroom for guests, private office or open to incorporate w/the living space. Large designer bathroom opens to the bedroom & living space. Vida is a full service, secure building that includes an attended lobby, social lounge, rooftop with BBQ and firepit, gym, bicycle parking, 2 elevators & 1 car parking with the tallest stacker vehicle clearance. Easy access to BART, MUNI & freeway. At the epicenter of shopping, restaurants & nightlife along the hip Valencia and Mission Corridors & minutes to Dolores Park, this home offers the ultimate urban lifestyle.
